system.effect: Once per turn, when you declare an attack using this weapon, choose one target of that attack. Reduce its base Movement by 2 units, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next Turn. This does not require the attack to hit.
system.special: Declaration timing and base Movement are draft clarifications. The original effect did not require a successful hit.
system.flavor: Reliable movement pressure from a one-handed platform.
